      "title": "MetaBrain - i-Ready rockstars list",
      "turn_index": 20,
      "role": "assistant",
      "snippet": "Here’s what I see after thinking it through:

This needs to be a reusable weekly template (not frozen to this week’s numbers).

You need to track real counts up to ~10 per subject, not just 0–2.

The goal is still 2 reading + 2 math, but the tool must let kids go way beyond that.

Messages should change automatically based on how many of the 4 “goal boxes” are filled and call out extra lessons.

So I rebuilt it as an interactive counter-based template:

You set a new week → everyone starts at 0."
